name: PK-3A rideable approximate closed-loop base track

surface_material.construction: nylon-resin GFRP/CFRP riding plate with a high-friction surface over a supported modular frame

source_basis.document: KR10-2234256 고분자 복합소재를 이용한 모듈러 펌프 트랙
facts_used: nylon resin reinforced with glass or carbon fibre
elastic riding feel and high tire grip
surface friction, tire wear, flexural strength and elastic modulus are design variables
anti-slip coating may be applied to the riding plate
epoxy and silica-sand mixture is given as an example

surface_material.calibration_notice: The patents do not publish a measured tire-surface friction coefficient. Sliding friction 1.1 is retained as a dry nominal simulation value and must be replaced by a tire-specific test result when available.

surface_contact.interpretation: Dry rubber-tire nominal grip; torsional and rolling resistance enabled; small compliant/damped layer represents the composite plate, anti-slip texture and tire carcass together

contact_solver.interpretation: Accurate friction cone and reduced soft-contact slip for the future wheeled robot
